plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: Live /radar pane: running tools, subagent roster, recent activity, files touched

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Refuses a tool call repeated N times in a row and tells the model to change approach

plugins.name: turn-recap
plugins.description: One-line toast after long turns: duration, tool calls, files edited

plugins.name: verify-gate
plugins.description: Runs the project's fast checks after edits and sends failures back to the model

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks secret-file writes, committing secrets, and pushes to main or force pushes

plugins.name: auto-checkpoint
plugins.description: Snapshots files before edits and risky commands; /rewind-to restores them

plugins.name: context-guardian
plugins.description: Warns at 70% context; at 85% tells the model to wrap up and /compact

plugins.name: cost-router
plugins.description: Status line with 5h usage and context %, usage toasts, cheaper models for subagents

plugins.name: break-time
plugins.description: Coffee-break reminder pane with an animated countdown
